posts.title: Welcome to the Official MITCORER Internship & Placement Community Forum!
posts.content: Use this community space to ask technical questions, share interview experiences, discuss weekly report deliverables, and connect with fellow MITCORER students across departments. Faculty coordinators and administrators actively monitor and answer queries here.

replies.content: Best wishes to all students preparing for upcoming industrial internships. Keep your weekly progress reports and Smart Resume updated for campus shortlisting!

opportunities.title: Full Stack Web Development Intern (Python & React)
opportunities.required_skills: Python, React, TypeScript, REST API, SQL, Git
opportunities.description: Build and optimize enterprise web dashboards, REST APIs, and responsive React interfaces under senior engineering mentorship.
opportunities.learning_outcomes: Production full-stack architecture, API security, automated testing, and agile sprint delivery.

opportunities.title: AI/ML & Data Science Engineering Intern
opportunities.required_skills: Python, Machine Learning, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, SQL, Data Visualization
opportunities.description: Develop predictive analytics pipelines, train classification models, and evaluate model accuracy on real industrial telemetry datasets.
opportunities.learning_outcomes: Feature engineering, model evaluation metrics, data preprocessing, and MLOps deployment basics.

opportunities.title: Embedded Systems & IoT Firmware Intern
opportunities.required_skills: Embedded C, Microcontrollers, RTOS, IoTProtocols, PCB Design, Verilog
opportunities.description: Work on automotive embedded microcontroller firmware, CAN bus diagnostics, and real-time sensor integration.
opportunities.learning_outcomes: Hardware-software co-design, RTOS task scheduling, and automotive grade embedded debugging.

opportunities.title: CAD/CAM & Industrial Automation Intern
opportunities.required_skills: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, ANSYS, Finite Element Analysis, CNC Machining, GD&T
opportunities.description: Design 3D mechanical assemblies, perform structural/thermal simulations in ANSYS, and assist in prototype validation.
opportunities.learning_outcomes: 3D parametric modeling, tolerance analysis, FEA stress verification, and manufacturing documentation.

opportunities.title: Structural Engineering & Railway Infrastructure Intern
opportunities.required_skills: AutoCAD Civil 3D, STAAD.Pro, Structural Analysis, Quantity Surveying, Concrete Technology, BIM
opportunities.description: Participate in railway bridge structural modeling, quantity estimation, and site quality verification under senior civil engineers.
opportunities.learning_outcomes: STAAD.Pro structural design, IS code compliance, site execution workflows, and BOQ preparation.

opportunities.title: Full-Stack Cloud & DevOps Industrial Certification Bootcamp
opportunities.organization: MITCORER T&P Cell & AWS Academy Partner
opportunities.eligibility_requirements: Open to all registered MITCORER students (CSE, E&TC, MECH, CIVIL).
opportunities.required_skills: Linux, Git, Docker, REST APIs, React, Cloud Deployment
opportunities.description: Hands-on training program covering containerization, CI/CD pipelines, REST API architecture, and cloud deployment with faculty-supervised capstone assessment.
opportunities.learning_outcomes: Deploy production microservices and earn a verifiable MITCORER + AWS Academy completion badge.

opportunities.title: Railway Signaling, Embedded IoT & Industrial Automation Workshop
opportunities.eligibility_requirements: Open to E&TC, Mechanical, Civil, and CSE engineering students.
opportunities.required_skills: Embedded C, Sensors, SCADA, Railway Signaling, PLC Basics
opportunities.description: Specialized practical training on modern railway signaling interlocks, IoT telemetry nodes, and predictive maintenance diagnostics.
opportunities.learning_outcomes: Interface industrial sensors and design fail-safe railway telemetry prototypes.

feedback.subject: PDF Certificate Download Issue on Mobile
feedback.description: When attempting to view or download verified internship completion certificates on a mobile browser, the PDF preview modal gets cropped at the bottom edge.

responses.message: We investigated the issue with the mobile viewport layout. Working on an update for the certificate rendering canvas.
Thank you sir, looking forward to the update.
Fix has been staged in the document viewer container styling.

feedback.subject: Automated Weekly Report Submission Reminders
feedback.description: It would be great to enable automated weekly email and system notifications every Friday to remind active interns to submit their weekly progress log before Sunday midnight.

responses.message: Approved for implementation in the next release cycle.

feedback.subject: Excellent AI Resume Analyzer & Mock Interview Experience!
feedback.description: The AI Resume analyzer and role-specific mock interview questions have been extremely helpful in preparing for Persistent Systems and Tech Mahindra campus drives.

responses.message: Glad to hear that! Keep leveraging the AI Assistant for campus placements.
